comment: Dr. Goldman is one of the best options for inorganic. She gives enough information for you to understand the general topic and do well on MCAT or other science exams; however, she does not bog you down in unnecessary detail and she does not make the class harder than it needs to be.Take her if you want to learn the subject but not drown in detail.

take dr goldman if u are nervous about chem 141. she offers so much help and wants you to succeed. she is such a easy grader and gives out lots of partial points. not much homework so you can actually have time to study for the test, but she still gives out practice problems. She's a chill lab instructor too and isn't too nit picky on accuracy.

In class professor Goldman went through a presentation for which she prepared a summary sheet, there were no surprise or weekly quizzes, just 3 tests that really straightforward and only asked about things we had discussed in class. Overall, great structure, but you have to learn material fast and do homework questions that were graded.

Dr. Goldman is a great professor, as she cares a lot about the students and how well they do in her class. She genuinely wants you to succeed. If you pay attention in the lecture and go over her slide shows, you will be completely fine. Make sure you are actively participating in lecture and understanding because concepts are clearly outlined.
Goldman cares about her students and takes every chance she can to reduce coursework or make lab reports shorter. Her lectures are easy to understand, and there is minimal homework. LOVE HER.

dr. goldman is an amazing gen chem professor! there are a lot of take home assignments, but they all help to drive home the point of the material. she holds review sessions for every test and gives you a lot of different ways to practice. she also likes to make lab reports as simple as possible.

Dr. Goldman makes intro chem simple and easy to understand. She is very accessible outside of class and will respond to emails at virtually any time. Her exams mirror the practice exams that she hands out, which is very helpful.

If you are forced into taking intro Chemistry without Goldman, good luck. It is extremely difficult compared to the material Goldman teaches and if you think Goldman is hard, then the other Chem 141 professors will tank your GPA. If you want to major in chem, take a regular 141 class so you can learn harder material that keeps you on pace.

Unintentionally very rude. Not good at teaching the information. Puts info never learned on the final exam. Lecture slides make absolutely no sense with little to no steps on them. No answers to check work. No corrections. Barely any EC, if at all. Have fun!

Really open to helping out if you need extra attention outside of class. Obviously cares about students. Sometimes explanations and teaching could be a bit confusing but if youre brave enough to ask shell try to help. Does a lot of cold calling on students during class.

Great professor, I took her fosr General Chemistry, not sure what the code is for that or if she still teaches it, but she really cares about her students, and if go to class, study for quizzes and tests, and turn in your assignments on time, you will get an A.

Dr. Goldman is a very nice person, but not the best professor. I found her lectures to be confusing & difficult to understand. I taught myself most of the material by reading the textbook. If you have a poor background in chem like I did, then this class will likely be difficult. However, its possible to get an A as long as you really work for it.

Dr. Goldman is a great professor for Chem 141. Although her lectures can sometimes be a little dry/ confusing, she is very accessible outside of class, and gives you plenty of resources to help you understand and practice the material. She is a nice woman and if you work hard and ask for help you will do well in the class.

Dr. Goldman is a good CHEM 141 professor. She explains concepts well and is always willing to help. She holds a review session the night before each exam, which is a good place to get any last minute questions answered. I definitely had to put in a lot of effort to do well, but I learned a lot!

Dr. Goldman will be your favorite person at the University of Richmond. If you have the privilege of taking one of her courses, you won't regret it. A well-respected MIT graduate, she has a passion for chemistry. She is the most genuine person. She understands the needs of her students, and tries to accommodate you. She evens comes in on weekends!

I luv herrr!! I have always been very anxious about chemistry despite taking courses in HS, but she really tries hard to answer questions, meet students, and explain concepts in ways to make it more memorable and interesting! She is a very reasonable and straightforward grader. Great that there are only prob sets and tests. Highly recommend!!!!!!!!

Dr. Goldman is amazing! As someone who hasn't taken Chem since sophomore year of HS, I was really scared of this class, but she was so helpful and willing to answer any questions. She gives a binder with basically all the notes you need on the first day of class + tests from the previous semester. She will go out of her way to meet with students

Good and easy teacher. The 2nd module of Inorganic Chem. involves difficult topics and she tries really hard to teach it and it comes down to you practicing outside of class and going to her for help. But no matter how hard the topic may get, tests will be easy once you practice.

Dr. Goldman is a fantastic professor. She explains the material very well during lecture time. You don't use the textbook much, but it is great to have for reference, as well as practice problems. She doesn't always understand the questions asked by students, but is helpful if you go in to meet with her.

Dr. Goldman is a great professor to begin your college chemistry classes. She tries to keep things simple and, often, tries to narrow things to a few basic ideas. She does not send a lot of work but if you want to get enough practice you have to work on the suggested book problems. She is truly nice.
Dr. Goldman is great. She gives binders full of notes and practice tests from old semesters, so it is very east to do well.

Best teacher ever. Gives you a binder full of notes. Gives you practice tests from semester before. Gives optional additional problems in textbook. Has review sessions for tests. Answers ANY question patiently. So nice. LOVES chemistry. Helped link class and lab. Overall amazing- take her.

Dr. Goldman is a great professor that I would definitely recommend. She is always willing to answer questions and clarify information. She is also always willing to meet outside of class if you are confused! She did a good job correlating what we were learning in class with what we were doing in lab that week so we understood the concepts.

Dr. Goldman is a great professor who is genuinely interested in the course material and genuinely cares about her students and how they do in the class. She offers review sessions before each test during the semester and also before the final. She also provides adequate examples to make course material easier to follow. I plan on taking her again!

She is easy if you have a good chemistry background. I would have been very confused if I did not have a general idea of what she was talking about before entering her class. However, she is very helpful and definitely wants her students to succeed.
Super helpful, clear about everything, offers bonuses on tests. I hate science, I hate Chemistry but she totally made the class, understandable, bearable and fun. TAKE HER you won't regret it!

She is the kindest, most helpful professor. See her for help if you need it-she loves that. Her initial explanations can be confusing, but she will go over it again in a simpler manner if you ask questions. I opened my book maybe twice-don't waste your money if you don't plan on doing extra problems. Bottom line: you want her to fill a requirement.

Dr. Goldman is funny and helpful, and she loves her subject. It can be difficult to understand where she's going in lecture sometimes, but usually if you ask, read her note packets or read the book it all works out. Her tests are easy if you know what you are doing, and her help with labs has been amazing for my grade!

Dr. Goldman is a great professor.  She gives you a healthy amount of material to use as notes in class, study guides, etc.  She will be available to help you most always and her study guides are just like the tests.  Overall great professor!

Dr. Goldman is "ok".  You can tell, however, that she isn't really thinking about how she can improve her teaching.  I imagine that uses the same problem sets and, probably the same exams, from year to year.  Very helpful, however, and you can do well if you go to office hours.  Straight forward in her approach, just not always very interesting.

Bad at explaining things, and expects you to know things that may or may not have been taught to you already...But a very nice person who wants you to do well.  Go in to see her and get help and it will help your grade.

Prof. Goldman is very fair. She's not the best at explaining (take Myers), but she doesn't hold you to as much as Myers. She gets frustrated if you aren't a science person. Pulling an A is very easy if you get the right lab teacher. Find another teacher to describe Molecular Orbital Theory, because I don't think that she gets it.

Emma is a fabulous professor!  Her tests are fair; the test questions are always straightforward.  Great in lab, too!  She is SO helpful outside of class if you have any questions; she always made everything seem so easy and could explain everything very well.  Offered study sessions twice a week and the night before exams. Take her!

Dr. Goldman is an easy teacher, but I found her class a little frustrating becuase she had a hard time controlling the class (ie too many questions, tangent topics, etc) and so it did not flow very well.  If you are looking for an easy A, take her, but if you don't want to be bored, take Myers.

Amazing teacher! Easily the best chemistry teacher in the department. I took her at 8:15 in the morning and it was definately worth it. She cares about her students and teaches the material clearly. Plus, what she teaches is exactly what appears on the exams. Also gives practice exams that are very similar to the actual tests. Easy A. Take her!
she's very nice and helpful. her tests were practically the same as the practice test she had given us.

Do not take her if you are not are a chem major. She will not help you if you are not a chem major and she will stop helping you if you are having trouble ( alot of trouble) in the class. Otherwise she is a good teacher.
No Comments
she ROCKS!
She's awesome.  If you're in chemistry, take her.  If you're fulfilling a requirement, take her.  She'll spend tons of time outside of class helping you.  So smart but so nice, you'll love her.
If you need to fulfill a chem requirement, TAKE HER.  If you want to relateively enjoy the burden of science, TAKE HER.  She's unbelievably nice, understanding, and very, very clear.  Kudos.
